title: Understanding Logarithms
text: When you see `np.log`, it refers to the natural logarithm, which is the logarithm to the base `e`. Consider how this operation affects the values of $$`time_{of,day}`$$. What happens when you take the logarithm of a number?

title: Range of Time of Day
text: The time of day is given as a range from $$0.0$$ to $$24.0$$. Think about what happens when you multiply these values by $$12$$. What range do you get?

title: Effect of Multiplication
text: What is the result of multiplying the time of day by 12?

title: Logarithm of a Range
text: Consider the range of values you get after multiplying by $$12$$. What happens when you take the logarithm of these values? Are there any values that might cause issues?

title: Logarithm of Zero
text: What is the logarithm of zero?
